newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Graham-Field started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Graham-Field started as buy.

text.p: Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc said Monday it was initiating coverage of Graham-Field Health Products Inc with a buy-focus rating because of the company's broad product lines and distribution programs.
-- Analyst Kurt Fish said in a research note he was setting a 12-month price target of $18 per share.
-- Fish said his 1997 earnings estimate was $0.49 per share and his 1998 estimate was $0.80.

-- "Graham-Field's product line, which currently exceeds 23,000 items, is significantly more expansive than its competitors'," he said. "The company's product distribution system is state of the art, with a fully automated 'paperless' warehouse and distribution system, and an expanding base of express delivery facilities in key markets."
